title: Line Extension Agreement: Signing, Estimate Validity and Contribution Billing (Line Extensions and New Service Construction)
content:
These terms govern the line extension agreement on a **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** project with Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative, from the issued estimate to the billing of the contribution.

**Term 1 — Member's act.** Signing the line extension agreement is the member's own act. The member signs on the issued estimate, and the project moves from estimate issued to contract signed status, the signing date being recorded on the project.

**Term 2 — Validity of the estimate.** The agreement may be signed only within the class's estimate validity period, in calendar days, after the estimate was issued. Calendar days are counted from the day after the estimate date, the last day of validity being the last day of the count. A signature on that last day is within the period; a signature on any later day is not. The judgement rests on the estimate date recorded on the project the agreement is signed on, compared with the date of signing.

**Term 3 — Expiry and restaking.** An unsigned estimate expires and a new estimate requires the restaking fee. The project then stands in estimate expired status, the original estimate date kept as issued; when the member asks for a new estimate the restaking fee is billed and the project returns to engineering.

**Term 4 — Billing on signing.** On signing, the contribution is billed as the class's contribution class (a nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction or a refundable advance), and the engineering design fee already paid is credited against it where the class credits the design fee on signing.

**Term 5 — Service term.** Where the class's service term is above zero months, the member agrees to take service at the location for that term.

## Counting the validity period (hypothetical estimates, 90-day validity period)

| Estimate date | Day 1 of the count | Last day of validity (day 90) | Signed on the last day | Signed the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 2 March | 30 May | Within the period | Not within the period |
| 15 November | 16 November | 13 February | Within the period | Not within the period |

The first row counts 30 days in March (2 to 31 March), 30 in April and 30 in May. The second counts 15 days in November (16 to 30 November), 31 in December, 31 in January and 13 in February. The estimate date itself is never counted.

## Signing judged on its two inputs

| Estimate status | Date of signing against the last day of validity | Agreement may be signed |
|---|---|---|
| Estimate issued | On or before the last day | Yes |
| Estimate issued | After the last day | No |

## Billing on signing (hypothetical Farm and Ranch Extension)

A hypothetical member's estimate shows a contribution of $6,000.00, and the $200.00 engineering design fee was billed and paid with the application. On signing, the $6,000.00 contribution is billed as a nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction, the class's contribution class, and the $200.00 already paid is credited against it, since the class credits the design fee on signing. The amount owed on the project after signing is $6,000.00 less $200.00, that is $5,800.00.
